Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

vellumverse (development version)

vellumverse 0.3.23

  • Bumped the pinned vellumwidget to (>= 0.20.0): big raster widgets draw their zoomed-in marks, lines and polygons with WebGL2. vellumplot is pinned to (>= 0.22.1); vellum (>= 0.15.0) is unchanged.

vellumverse 0.3.22

  • Bumped the pinned vellum to (>= 0.15.0), vellumplot to (>= 0.22.0) and vellumwidget to (>= 0.19.1). vellumplot 0.22.0 has breaking changes: a length-1 variable passed to a mark argument is a constant, inset() honours align_to (default "panel"), and theme_void() has no plot margin.

vellumverse 0.3.21

  • Bumped the pinned vellumplot to (>= 0.21.1): point legend keys of plots with tiny points no longer shrink below a readable minimum (theme(legend.key.point.min =)).

vellumverse 0.3.20

  • Bumped the pinned vellumplot to (>= 0.21.0); vellum (>= 0.14.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.19.0) are unchanged.
    • vellumplot 0.21.0: all 26 numeric point shapes draw as in ggplot2 (open, solid and bordered styles, R’s per-symbol sizes, composite glyphs for 7-14), legend keys take the layer’s point colour, size and shape and line keys its ink, mark_crossbar(width =) is in data units with a wider middle line, date axes judge each label pair by its own widths and keep short labels when sparse, and mapping shape to SVG paths warns.

vellumverse 0.3.19

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellumplot (>= 0.20.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.19.0); vellum stays at (>= 0.14.0).
    • vellumplot 0.20.0: mark_bar(width =) and mark_errorbar(width =) are in data units (error bars default to 0.9 of the band, as in ggplot2), tiles and rasters keep their end cells, open and bordered numeric point shapes draw as in ggplot2, drop = on size and alpha scales, date breaks account for label angle, dodged rows and legend width and keep at least two labels, edge-bundle legend keys are lines, and flow-map tooltips name their destinations.
    • vellumwidget 0.19.0: legends with two aesthetics ship up to 4x smaller payloads, and hollow marks draw as outlines in the fallback dots.

vellumverse 0.3.18

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.14.0), vellumplot (>= 0.19.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.18.0).
    • vellum 0.14.0: tweens match marks by data key with enter/exit fades, lines with different vertex counts morph, labels change per frame, animated SVGs are namespaced and share their gradients and clip paths (a five-bar colour bar animation drops from 2.9 MB to 0.9 MB), exact fps, faster GIF encoding, and bars, tiles and boxes on a reversed axis are drawn again.
    • vellumplot 0.19.0: animation identity by data_id/group, frame variables in labs() and mark_text(), transition_reveal() along any variable, Date/POSIXct times, facets, start/end pauses and rewind, anim_frame(), .apng output; unused factor levels are dropped from legends, bars on a continuous x keep their end widths, date breaks fit their labels, nudges follow coord_flip(), and effect underlays keep their series.
    • vellumwidget 0.18.0: play/pause and a scrubber for animations, render_options(autoplay, loop), per-row alpha in conditions, shaped fallback dots above max_marks, and keyboard focus kept on a raised mark.

vellumverse 0.3.17

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellumplot (>= 0.18.1) and vellumwidget (>= 0.17.0); vellum stays at (>= 0.13.0).
    • vellumplot 0.18.1: a per-row if_false colour reaches the widget as colours, condition tags no longer collide across composition cells, and a contour-style line with a constant colour per series draws as one path (about 100x fewer records on volcano contours).
    • vellumwidget 0.17.0: selected marks draw above the rest of their layer, a per-row if_false colours non-members, a constant if_false on alpha dims them to that opacity, brush and lasso hit constant-size marks where they are drawn, selection rings follow zoom and stay inside their panel, raster payloads with lines and polygons are up to 60% smaller, and a zoomed y axis moves its title clear of longer labels.

vellumverse 0.3.16

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.13.0), vellumplot (>= 0.18.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.16.0).
    • vellumplot 0.18.0: legend keys take the layer alpha (filled, point and line keys), faceted flow maps keep each panel’s own edges, flow-map branches are keyed for hover and selection, and two condition()s on one selection in different layers no longer collide.
    • vellumwidget 0.16.0: the browser payload is about half its former size (compact coordinates, binary keys, more tooltip patterns), zoom is capped at 100x by default (render_options(max_zoom =)), max_marks defaults to 2e6, rotated text and axis labels keep their rotation under axis zoom, and labels drawn from images keep their size when zoomed.
    • vellum 0.13.0: compact display-list coordinates, blend groups isolate in PDF output, and a blend inside a cached viewport renders correctly.

vellumverse 0.3.15

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.12.0), vellumplot (>= 0.17.1) and vellumwidget (>= 0.15.0).
    • Interactive builds are faster: a 200k-point widget builds in about 1 s (1.5 s before), a 1M-point one in about 4.5 s (8.4 s before), and faceted plots gain the most.
    • The 200k-point widget payload is less than half its former size (6.1 MB to 2.7 MB): element keys ship once and repeated or numbered tooltips are compressed. Hover text is unchanged.
    • Large clouds of filled circles render faster and closer to exact in PNG output.

vellumverse 0.3.14

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest patch releases: vellum (>= 0.11.1) and vellumwidget (>= 0.14.1). vellumplot stays at (>= 0.17.0).
    • vellum 0.11.1 fixes scene_svg() dropping blend modes, masks and layer effects inside panels, so a layer blend, clip_layer() or layer effect now shows in plot_svg() and the widget’s SVG mode.
    • vellumwidget 0.14.1 lets filters, conditions and dimming reach marks the display list can’t draw, and composites blend-mode marks in the zoomed tiers.

vellumverse 0.3.13

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.11.0), vellumplot (>= 0.17.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.14.0).
    • vellum 0.11.0 adds display-list version 2 (gradients, path clips, opacity groups) and a flagged-marks layer, so the widget can draw more marks exactly when zoomed.
    • vellumplot 0.17.0 follows ggplot2’s default area fill, recolours more defaults on dark themes, fixes faceted dodging, graph facets and jitterdodge, and lightens the default density fill. See its NEWS for the behaviour changes.
    • vellumwidget 0.14.0 exports conditions, filters and dimming as shown, keeps furniture constant-size under axis zoom, and draws gradients, clips and flagged marks in the zoomed tiers.

vellumverse 0.3.12

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.10.1), vellumplot (>= 0.16.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.13.1).
    • vellum 0.10.1 errors clearly on a missing or non-finite text size instead of measuring it as a huge negative width on Linux (0 on macOS).
    • vellumplot 0.16.0 adds element_geom(): themes set the default colours of unmapped marks, so theme_cyberpunk() no longer draws black points on its dark panel. Legends in aligned compositions follow their guide or theme position, and per-panel legends are collected when they would squeeze the panels. Several defaults now match ggplot2 or changed on purpose; see its NEWS under “Behaviour changes”: dodging splits each x between the groups present there, discrete alpha/size/linewidth group a layer, and default element keys name the panel, layer and row.
    • vellumwidget 0.13.1 ships the new default keys as compactly as plain row numbers.

vellumverse 0.3.11

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.10.0), vellumplot (>= 0.15.1) and vellumwidget (>= 0.13.0).
    • vellum 0.10.0 can render a scene’s marks and furniture as separate layers (scene_svg()/scene_png() layer =, including paint order) and export the marks as a display list (scene_display_list()). Large scatter plots rasterise much faster.
    • vellumplot 0.15.1 compiles big plots faster and no longer keys annotate() layers just because the plot declares a selection.
    • vellumwidget 0.13.0 makes large raster plots fully interactive: axis zoom, the navigator and linked zoom work, zooming draws exact marks, and zoomed in far enough the marks become real SVG nodes. Selections, condition() and filter_by() show at every zoom level, and the payload is up to 5x smaller. A 200k-point widget builds in about 1.6 s instead of 7 s.

vellumverse 0.3.10

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.9.0), vellumplot (>= 0.15.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.12.0).
    • vellum 0.9.0 writes one SVG element per filled-and-outlined shape (about half the size for scatter plots) and adds a cached spatial index with vl_brush() and vl_lasso() for region queries; vl_nearest() is much faster.
    • vellumplot 0.15.0 gives color and fill separate scales and legends, as in ggplot2, and works alongside an attached ggplot2 again. It adds brush-driven linked zoom (bind_scale(), select_interval(bind = "scales")), legends beside each facet panel (guide_legend(position = "panel")) and guide_bins(), and groups layers by all their discrete aesthetics. Several defaults changed; see its NEWS under “Behaviour changes”.
    • vellumwidget 0.12.0 supports one-element points and linked zoom, and fixes zoomed gridlines, brushed lines and the selection colour on dark plots.

vellumverse 0.3.9

  • Bumped the vellumplot pin to the latest release, vellumplot (>= 0.14.0). vellumplot 0.14.0 adds ggplot2’s remaining common scale constructors (manual shape/linetype/size/alpha, hue, grey, fermenter, log10/sqrt/reverse and more), new marks (mark_rect(), mark_polygon(), mark_path(), mark_curve(), mark_spoke(), mark_density_2d(), mark_quantile()), guide_axis(), and independent colour/size legends per facet panel via resolve_scale(). A color given with a fill now outlines filled marks, as in ggplot2; see its NEWS under “Behaviour changes”.

vellumverse 0.3.8

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.8.1), vellumplot (>= 0.13.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.11.0).
    • vellum 0.8.1 writes smaller SVG and gives SVG ids that are stable across renders and unique between plots on one page.
    • vellumplot 0.13.0 closes many ggplot2 parity gaps: histogram binning, mark_freqpoly(), mark_summary(fun.data), horizontal box plots and violins, facet labellers, scale_*_discrete(breaks, labels, drop), oob, and legends inside the panel. Several defaults now match ggplot2; see its NEWS under “Behaviour changes”.
    • vellumwidget 0.11.0 groups as_widget() settings into option helpers (tooltip_options(), export_options(), navigator_options(), render_options()), reports zoom per panel, and fixes linking after a group change.
  • library(vellumverse) no longer reports a block of conflicts inside the family. vellumplot now re-exports vellum’s md(), vl_pattern(), sketch(), linear_gradient() and radial_gradient() rather than wrapping them, so those are identical and not reported at all. The two that genuinely differ, vellumplot’s pdf_pages() and render_all(), are summarised on one line. Conflicts with packages outside the family are listed as before. vellumverse_conflicts() entries gain a family flag (VV-2).

vellumverse 0.3.7

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.8.0), vellumplot (>= 0.12.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.10.0).
    • vellum 0.8.0 has one breaking change: a bare number now means "npc" in every constructor. lines_grob(), polygon_grob(), segments_grob(), path_grob() and the curve and hexagon/sector size arguments used "native". Pass default_units = "native" for the old behaviour. Inputs are now validated with clear errors.
    • vellumplot 0.12.0 adds select_interval(), bivariate choropleths, tapered mapped linewidth, spec_diagnose() and rel(). It also fixes stacking, NA categories and facets, legend merging, and date breaks.
    • vellumwidget 0.10.0 adds a data-value brush and re-ticks log, date and discrete axes under zoom.

vellumverse 0.3.6

  • Bumped the pinned versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.7.2), vellumplot (>= 0.11.1) and vellumwidget (>= 0.9.1). Every geometry query and the widget now pick what is actually drawn (a polygon’s hole is no longer a hit, offset and capped lines are picked where they are drawn), and PNG, SVG and PDF agree on dashes and pattern strokes.

vellumverse 0.3.5

  • Bumped the pinned vellumplot version to the latest release (>= 0.11.0), which brings the group aesthetic, dodge/stack for every mark, and ggplot2 color/fill semantics on box plots, violins and ridgelines.

vellumverse 0.3.4

  • Bumped the pinned ecosystem versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.7.1), vellumplot (>= 0.10.0), and vellumwidget (>= 0.9.0).

  • options(vellumverse.quiet = TRUE) no longer stops the core packages from being attached. The option returned from the attach hook before anything was loaded, so library(vellumverse) put only vellumverse itself on the search path. As in tidyverse, the option now only silences the startup banner and the conflict report; vellum, vellumplot and vellumwidget are attached either way.

vellumverse 0.3.3

  • Bumped the pinned ecosystem versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.6.6), vellumplot (>= 0.9.0), and vellumwidget (>= 0.8.0).

vellumverse 0.3.2

  • Bumped the pinned ecosystem versions to the latest releases: vellumplot (>= 0.8.0) and vellumwidget (>= 0.7.0); vellum stays at (>= 0.5.1).

vellumverse 0.3.1

  • Bumped the pinned ecosystem versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.5.0), vellumplot (>= 0.6.0), and vellumwidget (>= 0.6.0).

vellumverse 0.3.0

  • Bumped the pinned ecosystem versions to the latest releases: vellum (>= 0.4.0), vellumplot (>= 0.5.0), and vellumwidget (>= 0.5.0).

vellumverse 0.2.1

  • Maintenance release. Declared the stats dependency (used when reporting ecosystem conflicts), dropped the unused rlang dependency to keep the meta-package dependency-light, and removed a dead startup argument from the vellumverse_conflicts() print method.

vellumverse 0.2.0

  • Adopted vellum’s renamed vl_* graphics primitives (grid collision fix).

vellumverse 0.1.0

First release.

  • library(vellumverse) attaches the core of the vellum graphics ecosystem (vellum, vellumplot, and vellumwidget) in one step and reports which versions were loaded.
  • vellumverse_packages() lists the bundled packages and vellumverse_conflicts() surfaces functions masked across the ecosystem.
  • Set options(vellumverse.quiet = TRUE) to attach without the startup banner.
